chapter_summary: Chapter 12 is a market/instrument-selection guide, not a technical chapter: it compares the Emini, Russell, SPY, QQQ, DIA/Dow futures, forex, Treasury bond/note futures, and a watchlist of individual stocks on liquidity, slippage, tick size, and typical scalp/swing size, and recommends starting with the SPY before scaling into the Emini. It contains no bar-by-bar OHLCV conditions - every statement is about which instrument or account size to trade, which the mining brief's reject criteria (or plain non-mechanizability) rule out.
